deals.name: SpaceX / xAI
deals.summary: SpaceX folded xAI into its stack, combining launch, satellite and compute with foundation-model research. Press-reported equity value ~$250B; parties did not disclose terms.
deals.detail: Both companies were already controlled by Elon Musk. Folding xAI into SpaceX was presented as a way to put model training next to SpaceX and Starlink compute. Official terms were not filed.
deals.headline: SpaceX Absorbs xAI in Combination of Launch, Satellite and AI

deals.name: Paramount Skydance / Warner Bros. Discovery
deals.summary: All-cash offer of $31.00 per share (~$110B enterprise value). DOJ cleared; state attorneys general and guild suits keep the deal in litigation, with trial set for March 2027.
deals.detail: Paramount Skydance’s cash bid prevailed over a signed Netflix combination. Federal clearance did not end state-AG and guild litigation.
deals.headline: Paramount Skydance Agrees $31-a-Share Cash Bid for Warner Bros. Discovery

deals.name: Union Pacific / Norfolk Southern
deals.summary: $85B cash-and-stock combination to create the first single-company U.S. transcontinental freight railroad. Surface Transportation Board review is underway; close targeted mid-2027.
deals.detail: The STB accepted an amended application in May 2026 and later set a merits schedule. Close is targeted mid-2027.
deals.headline: Union Pacific to Buy Norfolk Southern in $85 Billion Railroad Merger

deals.name: Equity Residential / AvalonBay
deals.summary: All-stock merger of equals creating the largest U.S. apartment landlord, with a combined enterprise value of about $69B and more than 180,000 units.
deals.detail: AvalonBay holders would receive 2.793 Equity Residential shares per AvalonBay share.
deals.headline: Equity Residential and AvalonBay Agree All-Stock Apartment Merger

deals.name: PIF / Silver Lake / Affinity — Electronic Arts
deals.summary: Record $55B leveraged buyout took EA private at $210 per share. Closed 4 Aug 2026. PIF holds the controlling stake.
deals.detail: The consortium paid $210 a share. PIF is the controlling owner. The deal closed 4 August 2026.
deals.tags: electronic arts ea pif silver lake
deals.headline: PIF, Silver Lake and Affinity Take Electronic Arts Private in $55 Billion LBO

deals.name: Devon Energy / Coterra Energy
deals.summary: All-stock shale combination joining Permian, Eagle Ford and Marcellus positions. Combined enterprise value reported near $58B; closed 7 May 2026.
deals.detail: Coterra holders received 0.70 Devon shares per Coterra share. The deal closed 7 May 2026.
deals.headline: Devon Energy and Coterra Energy Combine in All-Stock Shale Merger

deals.name: Nvidia / Hugging Face
deals.summary: Nvidia agreed to buy the open-source AI model and data platform for about $12.9B, deepening its role as infrastructure and software backer to the model ecosystem.
deals.detail: The purchase puts a major public model hub under a chip supplier. Closing remains pending.
deals.headline: Nvidia Agrees to Acquire Hugging Face for About $12.9 Billion

deals.name: Fox Corporation / Roku
deals.summary: Fox is buying the streaming platform in a cash-and-stock deal valuing Roku at about $22B, pairing live sports and news with a 100-million-household device network.
deals.detail: Consideration was reported as cash and Fox Class A shares. Shareholder and regulatory steps remain.
deals.headline: Fox Agrees to Buy Roku in Cash-and-Stock Deal Valued at About $22 Billion

deals.name: Aon / USI
deals.summary: Aon agreed to acquire KKR-owned insurance broker USI for about $17B, adding mid-market commercial brokerage scale in the United States.
deals.detail: USI is a U.S. mid-market commercial broker. Closing depends on insurance and antitrust review.
deals.headline: Aon to Acquire KKR-Owned Insurance Broker USI for About $17 Billion

deals.name: Copart / ACV Auctions
deals.summary: Online salvage auctioneer Copart agreed to buy ACV Auctions for about $1.9B cash, entering dealer-to-dealer wholesale remarketing.
deals.detail: The deal expands Copart from insurance salvage into dealer wholesale auctions.
deals.headline: Copart Agrees to Buy ACV Auctions for About $1.9 Billion Cash

deals.name: Bending Spoons / Miro
deals.summary: Italian software consolidator Bending Spoons agreed to acquire digital whiteboard company Miro in an all-cash deal valuing the platform at $1.36B.
deals.detail: All-cash acquisition announced 10 September 2026. Customary technology-deal clearances remain.
deals.headline: Bending Spoons to Acquire Miro in $1.36 Billion All-Cash Deal

deals.name: Enbridge / Tallgrass crude business
deals.summary: Enbridge will buy Blackstone-owned Tallgrass Energy’s crude oil business for $2.55B cash, including a majority stake in the Pony Express Pipeline.
deals.detail: The purchase extends Enbridge’s U.S. liquids network, including Pony Express.
deals.headline: Enbridge to Buy Tallgrass Crude Business for $2.55 Billion Cash
